name: Néstor Gorosito
summary: Néstor Gorosito has 2 coaching stints at 2 clubs (40 league games) in the dataset, from 2009/10 to 2015/16. Too few games for a grade (the ranking requires at least 3 stints and 10 games). The best stint above squad-value expectation was Xerez CD 2009/10 (+0.44 PPG); the toughest was UD Almería 2015/16 (-0.24 PPG).
